title: From a Flower Basket to a Seat
summary: Follow a signed basket to one of 18 map-wall mats, then read a real seat code in Street Corner’s four eight-tier stands. The November 27 rehearsal clocks Donna’s reply and the seat glow separately.
summary_zh: 沿署名贺卡找到地图墙边 18 块花篮垫中的一块，再按座号找到四面八排看台中的席位。11 月 27 日排练分别记录了 Donna 的响应和座位亮灯时间。
style: dual-polarity optical glass · map-wall elevation, arena plan and rehearsal clocks
